rationale: Ocean delay mean set to 6.06 days, the average delay of late vessel arrivals reported by Sea-Intelligence for July 2026 (GLP). Deterministic plans do not change, but the on-time probability of the ocean plan should drop below 0.2 (base: 0.306).
falsifier: Refuted if the cost-optimal plan changes, or if its on-time probability is 0.2 or higher.
